summary: Build and validate lazy tabular plans with explicit schemas, invariants, inspected execution, bounded collection, and resource evidence.
triggers: A table pipeline should defer work until a measured materialization boundary.
Schema drift, join cardinality, nulls, keys, or resource use need explicit validation.
A logical plan must be inspected before collecting or writing results.
antiTriggers: Read arbitrary datasets outside the supplied scope.
Collect an unbounded plan into memory.
Call a sampled or partial result proof of full-data completeness.
